title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: count of currently unpaid billing cycles
content:
Under the Corporate Wellness Partnership, the number of currently unpaid billing cycles on an enrollment is the count of dues charges already recorded in that enrollment's billing history, minus the count of payments already recorded in that same history, floored at zero so the count is never negative.

Worked example (hypothetical): if an enrollment's billing history showed 4 dues charges and 2 payments, the number of currently unpaid billing cycles would be 2. If instead it showed 3 dues charges and 3 payments, the number of currently unpaid billing cycles would be floored at 0 rather than a negative figure.
